# Switchboard

> Graph-based planning for MCP tools. The website includes interactive recorded examples. The website is browser-local. A separate real HydraDB API is available as a public synthetic-data demo.

Canonical website: https://switchboardx.vercel.app/
Open-source repository: https://github.com/ramnnn2006/switchboardx
Package name: switchhboard-mcp (publication pending; double h).
Separate public API health: https://switchhboard-mcp-api.onrender.com/api/health
The API is unauthenticated, including run reports. Use synthetic or public data only. Do not send private tasks, personal memory or credentials.

## Pages
- [Ask](https://switchboardx.vercel.app/ask): Interactive recorded tool plans, dependencies, known values and exclusions.
- [Explore](https://switchboardx.vercel.app/explore): Browse the reference MCP tool catalog and schemas.
- [Why](https://switchboardx.vercel.app/why): Dependency-graph planning explanation.
- [Bench](https://switchboardx.vercel.app/bench): Clearly labeled reference benchmarks, not proof of current backend performance.
- [Guard](https://switchboardx.vercel.app/guard): Interactive risky-chain plan-flag demo, not an execution security guarantee.
- [Runs](https://switchboardx.vercel.app/runs): Sample run journal. Account memory is not connected.
- [Docs](https://switchboardx.vercel.app/docs): Setup guidance and current backend status.

## Current limits
Real HydraDB integration and learning checks passed in CI. Hosted planning and guard smoke tests passed. These are bounded tests, not a security or performance guarantee. The API container build remains unresolved; the hosted API uses native Node. Free hosting can sleep or reset its data.

The website does not call the hosted API. It plans in your browser from the bundled catalog and recorded examples; website reports stay in browser-local storage. Authentication previews do not create accounts or store passwords. My memory is not private cloud storage. No account-backed persistence is available.
